meta_description: Andy Coggins is a trusted painter and decorator in Bristol. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, reliable service. Call today.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting done right. Free quotes, no mess, work you'll be proud of.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Bristol
services_subhead: From feature walls to full house repaints, we handle every job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork and feature walls painted to a flawless finish. We prep properly, use quality paint, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof coatings for fascias, soffits, doors and brickwork. We work in all seasons and protect your home against rain and frost damage.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Pattern-matched hanging and expert removal of old paper. We take time to get corners and seams perfect, even on textured surfaces.

services.title: Woodwork Restoration
services.desc: Strip, sand and repaint skirting, doors, frames and shutters. Bring tired woodwork back to life with hard-wearing finishes that last.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office and retail spaces painted to schedule, with minimal disruption. We work evenings and weekends to fit your business timetable.

services.title: Property Preparation
services.desc: Pre-sale or rental spruce-ups that add real appeal. We focus on the details that buyers and tenants notice first.

about_pullquote: Good decorating shouldn't break the bank or leave your home in chaos.
about_para_1: I started decorating over 20 years ago after watching my own home get ruined by a cowboys outfit. I vowed to do things properly — honest prices, quality materials, and work I'd be happy to show my own family. Since then, I've built a reputation across Bristol for turning homes into spaces people actually love.
about_para_2: Repeat customers make up more than half my work, which tells you everything. I take pride in being reliable, tidy and straightforward — no hidden costs, no rushed job, no excuses. Whether it's a single bedroom or a five-bedroom family home, I approach every project the same way: right the first time.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Andy

reviews.text: Had Andy paint the whole interior of our house before we moved in. Really professional bloke, turned up on time, and the finish is brilliant. Couldn't find a drip anywhere. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: We were dreading getting someone in because of the mess, but Andy was incredibly tidy. Put dust sheets down, cleaned up every day, and left our lounge looking spotless. Great price too, no surprises on the bill.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Had external work done on a Victorian property. Andy understood what needed doing and didn't try to oversell us anything. The preparation was thorough and the paint job has held up beautifully through winter. Very happy.
reviews.author: David S.
